title: Five-Word Discrete Vocabulary Joint BiGAN Smoke
intuition: Trains a joint BiGAN (generator, encoder, joint critic) with exactly 5 learned 2D particles on a 5-word discrete vocabulary ('apple', 'grape', 'lemon', 'melon', 'berry'). Must generate all 5 words cleanly and reconstruct every word with >= 0.90 token confidence.
failure_mode: Two words collide onto one particle or the encoder fails to invert the generator's discrete assignments, breaking exact reconstruction.
protocol_notes: Tier-1 required gate; produces the checkpoint continued by `five_word_joint_hold`.
